attribution.modifications: Original texture-free flat-colour geometry on the 3DBAG LoD2.2 shell (CC BY 4.0) of BAG pand 0363100012165430 (CC0): the rusticated hardstone ground storey, the red-brick wings with yellow-brick panels and archivolts over round-headed windows, the yellow-brick corner and middle risalits between colossal sandstone pilasters, the balcony and entrance porch, the lettered frieze, the modillion cornice, urns and aedicule dormers on the slate mansard, read from Gemeente Amsterdam panoramas (CC BY 4.0).
